speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: One, I know we are increasing the number of nurses.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Could I also ask whether we are equally putting in an amount of effort in increasing the number of support healthcare staff as well?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Second, I am very glad we have announced the Award for Nurses' Grace, Excellence and Loyalty (ANGEL) scheme for nurses.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I am just wondering whether we could also extend that to the administrative and support healthcare workers that work alongside the nurses.
